metadata.title: High-Contrast Monochrome Trio Portrait with Graphic Strikethrough

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast black and white trio portrait set against a pure white void, featuring a bold graphic title with a diagonal slash intervention.
triggerTerms: magenta text on black and white photo

recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, studio-lit black and white photograph of three people arranged in a triangular formation against a seamless white backdrop, topped with centered, modern sans-serif typography that includes a distinctive diagonal slash through the primary title.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast monochrome subjects against a flat white negative space
Triangular human composition with the central figure slightly forward
Vibrant magenta accent color cutting through the grayscale palette
Top-heavy typographic hierarchy centered above the subjects
coreInvariants: Pure white background with minimal floor shadow
High-key lighting with deep black shadows for texture
Diagonal graphic slash through the main title text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects centered horizontally, occupying the bottom two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central female figure's face and the vibrant magenta title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold magenta title, moves down to the central figure, then scans outward to the flanking figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space at the top and sides to emphasize the subjects and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white background for stark isolation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and grays in the subjects' clothing and hair.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant magenta for the primary title and graphic slash.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between subjects and background; zero saturation in imagery, high saturation in text.

letterConstructionRules: Wide tracking for the secondary line
Tight tracking for the primary title
A 45-degree diagonal slash intersecting the central characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'B' or central character is bisected by a sharp diagonal line that extends beyond the letter boundaries.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold geometric display paired with a lighter, wide-tracked secondary sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric weight and clean terminals for the display text.
Excellent for the wide-tracked secondary text to maintain modern clarity.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white studio portrait of three people (two men, one woman) against a seamless white background. The lighting should be bright and direct, creating sharp textures in clothing and hair. Leave the top third of the image as empty white space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered uppercase text in the top third. The top line should be black with wide tracking. The bottom line should be large, bold magenta, with a sharp diagonal magenta slash cutting through the middle of the word.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white while the text is magenta?
Does the diagonal slash extend slightly beyond the letter it crosses?
Is the trio arranged in a tight, centered cluster?

adjustableVariables: Accent color (magenta can be swapped for cyan or yellow)
Subject count (can work for duos or quartets)
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific band name or album title
Do not replicate the specific faces of the artists
Do not copy the exact tattoo designs
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is perfectly centered horizontally
Verify the diagonal slash is a clean geometric line
Confirm high-contrast texture in the subjects' clothing
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast B&W trio + Pure white void + Geometric Sans + Graphic Slash Intervention
